run_boost_build_test: run a BoostBuild test that verifies build system behavior with a Tester instance
write_test_file: write a source or Jamfile to the test directory using the Tester write method
run_build_system: run the Boost.Build system against the test files and capture output
expect_file_addition: assert that a specific file was added to the test directory after building
cleanup_test_artifacts: clean up all test artifacts and temporary files created during the test run
